WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT s.arcref AS project_reference,
         p.fundflux AS funding_source,
         SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) AS size_per_minute_rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(size_per_minute_rate) AS average_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT g.project_reference,
       g.funding_source,
       g.size_per_minute_rate,
       g.size_per_minute_rate - b.average_rate AS excess_rate
FROM group_rates AS g
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE g.size_per_minute_rate > b.average_rate
ORDER BY excess_rate DESC
LIMIT 10
